auth_default: off (basicAuthMode: false); network-exposure gate is whitelistMode, commonly disabled via securityOverride: true

default_creds.context: No default credential pair -- basicAuthMode ships false. Operator risk is the whitelist/securityOverride gate being disabled entirely, not a copy-pasted password.

install_tell: node server.js  (default config.yaml: listen:false, whitelistMode:true, basicAuthMode:false, securityOverride:false -- operator must flip listen:true AND either keep whitelistMode or set securityOverride:true to expose)
misconfig_patterns: listen:true + securityOverride:true + whitelistMode left true but whitelist.txt empty/0.0.0.0 -- full open exposure, vendor explicitly warns against this in docs
basicAuthMode left false on an internet-exposed instance -- no credential layer at all
Pre-fix versions vulnerable to CVE-2025-59159 (CVSS 9.7, full remote control of local AI instance)
Pre-fix versions vulnerable to unauthenticated path-traversal directory deletion via /api/extensions/delete (and /update, /version, /branches, /switch share the flawed pattern)
Pre-1.18.0 CORS proxy at /proxy/:url -- unauthenticated SSRF, no redirect validation, external server can redirect to internal resource
CVE-2026-44649 SSO auth bypass -- unauthenticated header injection logs in as any user including admin, given direct network access to the port

active_probe.false_positive_check: response body must be JSON containing pkgVersion field; distinguishes from generic Node apps on 8000
active_probe.auth_discriminator: GET / status code is the real auth gate, NOT platform-match presence: 200 direct = whitelistMode/basicAuth off, likely unauthenticated (verify with GET /version returning pkgVersion JSON); 302 = redirected to a login/whitelist-block flow, gated. Ground-truthed 2026-07-13 on a 96-host cat-01 sample: 66/87 confirmed-platform hosts were 302-gated, 21/87 were 200-direct with unauth /version reads. A fingerprint that stops at title/path match without checking this status code will flatten the whole population to one auth state (false-negative on the unauth subset).

deployment_tells: Port 8000 serving title 'SillyTavern', noindex/nofollow meta robots tag (won't suppress Shodan crawl, only search-engine indexing)
Static assets st-tailwind.css, rm-groups.css, group-avatars.css, world-info.css
Preset panels referencing Kobold/NovelAI/OpenAI/TextGenerationWebUI backends -- distinguishes from a generic Node.js chat app
pivot_paths: GET /version -- pkgVersion + gitRevision, scopes exact CVE applicability
POST /api/extensions/delete -- unauthenticated path traversal directory deletion on unpatched versions
GET /proxy/:url -- unauthenticated SSRF via CORS proxy on pre-1.18.0
Header-injection SSO bypass (CVE-2026-44649) -- login as any user incl. admin with no prior auth, direct network access only
/api/settings/get -- exposes configured backend API keys/endpoints if operator stored them server-side rather than browser-local
vulnerabilities: CVE-2025-59159 CVSS 9.7: full remote control of local AI instance
CVE-2026-44649: SSO authentication bypass via HTTP header injection -- unauthenticated attacker logs in as any user incl. admin
Unauthenticated path traversal / directory deletion via /api/extensions/delete (same flawed pattern in /update, /version, /branches, /switch)
CORS proxy SSRF via /proxy/:url, unauthenticated, no redirect validation, pre-1.18.0
CVE-2026-46372: SSRF via /api/search/searxng baseUrl param -- requires an authenticated low-priv session, not directly unauth
